Financing-dependent fragility

Authored conditional interpretation · issue-6-engineer · assessment:issue6:fragility:1

Interpretation
if realized paid demand does not cover serving/training outlay and payable compute obligations without new finance, apparent expansion could mask fragile cash economics. No current loss, subsidy or bubble is declared.
Assumptions (not measured)
unfavorable retained-demand contribution; material cash obligations distinct from announcements; limited ability to reduce/restructure spending; financing not guaranteed. All remain unknown.
Strongest available counterevidence / limit
the acquired secondary revenue baseline supplies a concrete alternative to “no economic activity”; diversified partners could provide a buffer under A’s unmeasured premises. This is a source-backed reason not to equate absent private numbers with a proved collapse. There is no direct measured counterexample for private-lab fragility in this pack.
Observable invalidation
obtain qualified retained-customer cohorts with positive realized contribution plus same-period completed cash receipts/available liquidity sufficient for training outlay and contractual payments without uncommitted future funding. Announced rounds, run rates, cloud credits or a promised IPO alone do not invalidate B.
